title: PR 2c — opt-in tax restatement of legacy gross purchases (amend-reversal + 3-line repost, per tax year, preview first)

goals.text: Fake-ledger golden values: restating a legacy gross (untyped) AU expense ($110 incl $10 GST) writes exactly expense_amend_reversal + expense_amend keyed by the superseded entry (no new key family), dated the original's date, replacement DR category 10000 | DR 2100 1000 | CR cash 11000; P&L expense 11000 → 10000, 2100 +1000, cash-basis expense 10000; the row is typed (GST, recoverable 1000, taxAmountCents unchanged). Second run and two concurrent runs are no-ops (typed-and-unchanged-entry guard, mutation-checked). Closed-period rows are skipped and listed (period_closed). A later delete nets every account to zero; a later amount amend reprices the 3-line shape. CA ON HST meals recover 50%, the vendor default code wins and a ZERO code disagreeing with the stored tax is skipped (tax_mismatch, >2c never reinterpreted); a row with no tax amount is never given recoverable tax. US, non-registrants and unknown registration have nothing to restate. Tenant-scoped; deleted-then-restored and split rows are skipped.

Real Next handler GET/POST /api/v1/agentbook-tax/restatement over the fake ledger: preview reports the P&L delta, counts and per-row recoverable tax and writes nothing; apply restates once and a second apply writes nothing; the tenant comes from the session; expenseIds restricts apply to those rows and another tenant's id is 404 with nothing written; malformed year 400; non-registrant 422 not_registered. Mutation-checked (apply call site, subset filter, ownership 404).

Settings › Business Profile restatement card (AU/CA registrants only): per-tax-year preview (count, recoverable tax, P&L delta, closed / other / already-typed counts, rows), Apply only after an explicit confirm (the first click POSTs nothing), result, then 'nothing to restate'. The BAS / GST-HST return and the P&L footnote a year with unrestated legacy rows and drop the note once applied (and never for US / non-registrants); fr-CA renders French with U+2019. Chat skills restatement-preview and restatement-apply (confirmBefore: the plan names the tax year, nothing is fetched until yes) reached through the real consultation triage for en / fr-CA / zh-CN phrasings; French retirement talk is not routed there.

launch.rollback: Revert the PR. No schema change (taxCode / recoverableTaxCents shipped in 2b). Rows restated meanwhile stay typed with balanced expense_amend entries (DR category net | DR 2100 recoverable | CR cash gross) and keep editing/deleting correctly through the PR 2a typed repost, which stays on main; nothing needs unwinding. To undo one restatement, delete and re-enter the expense.
